description: This PHP class defines a data model for representing internationalization import errors within the OrangeHRM system's administration API. It implements serialization and normalization features for API responses, encapsulating error details related to language string imports.

classes.name: I18NImportErrorModel
classes.description: A model class representing internationalization import errors for API responses, including properties for error identifiers and messages, with serialization support.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the model by associating it with an I18NImportError entity and configuring serialization filters and attribute mappings.
